result.title: PathOPEN: A pathologist-curated histopathology dataset for visual question answering
result.comment: 38 pages including supplementary material and appendices, 8 main figures and 1 supplementary figure. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24358341
result.summary: PathOPEN is a histopathology dataset for visual question answering. Two clinical pathologists selected 157 cases with 229 available original images and wrote open-ended, five-option multiple-choice and close-ended (yes/no) questions. They supplied both a correct and a wrong answer for 201 of the 309 open-ended questions. Each case records the organ, pathology category and regional anatomy, and each image records its magnification. The dataset includes 6,870 augmented images and four manifests that select subsets to improve balance by individual metadata field. Five additional pathologists and two vision-language model judges rated items with scoring rubrics, and six models answered questions zero-shot across the three formats. The metadata support subgroup evaluation, and the paired answers can be used to construct preference examples.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建了一个病理组织学视觉问答数据集：由病理学家挑选 157 个病例、229 张原始图像，编写开放式、五选一和是非三种题型的题目，并为 201 道开放题同时提供正确与错误答案，配以器官、病理类别、图像放大倍数等元数据和 6,870 张增强图像，另做多评分者打分与六个模型的零样本评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 正误答案配对与放大倍数等元数据可能可供核查模型回答是否真正依赖视觉证据、以及按视觉细节粒度做分组评估，但其本身不涉及 latent 推理状态或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 类机制，联系较远。
